basis: IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 rules; sources read, not executed
limit: Review of expectations, not execution or qualification; open-source reference, not mainframe-proven

replaced.derivation: PIC S9(3) DISPLAY viewed through X(3); addends are data items so the arithmetic cannot be elided. '12C' + 0 = +123 stored 12C. '12L' + 0 = -123 stored 12L. '123' (zone F, read as +123 under NOPFD) + 0 stored with the preferred positive sign: 12C. '123' + 1 = +124 stored 12D. MOVE 0 stores 00{. MOVE -5 stores 00N. Each value is displayed on its own line; no early exit.
replaced.open_point: If the third line is observed as 123, GnuCOBOL does not rewrite a zone-F sign on arithmetic that leaves the value unchanged. That would be recorded as a named limit of the reference (signed inputs must carry preferred signs) by a separate decision; it is not pre-approved here.
replaced.why_replaced: The earlier zoned-signs probe (e46c8a0b...) exited 16 in run 43802256781. Its specification, written by Claude, added the literal 0, which the compiler can drop, and it stopped at the first failed check. That source and result stay on record.
